## meanBy() function

返回对每个元素应用 `f` 后的值的平均值。空 iterable 返回 `NaN`。

**Signature:**

```typescript
function meanBy<A>(f: (a: A) => number, iterable: Iterable<A>): number;
function meanBy<A>(
  f: (a: A) => number,
  iterable: AsyncIterable<A>,
): Promise<number>;
```

## Example

```ts
meanBy(
  (a) => a.score,
  [
    { name: "a", score: 80 },
    { name: "b", score: 100 },
  ],
); // 90

meanBy((a) => a.score, []); // NaN

pipe(
  [{ score: 80 }, { score: 100 }],
  meanBy((a) => a.score),
); // 90
```
